messages.text: Hey, I bought the monitor stand in three credit-card instalments. I returned it already. Will the instalments complicate my refund?

Three instalments won’t complicate the refund by themselves: instalments of one credit-card payment count as one payment record. The refund goes to that original payment, not a different card or account. [refund-policy/v2/payment]

Would you like me to find the returned monitor stand and start a refund request?

continuation.content:
